title: FRS 101 — Reduced Disclosure Framework | Extended Reference
summary: FRS 101 provides a reduced disclosure framework for qualifying entities within an IFRS group, allowing them to use full IFRS recognition and measurement with disclosure exemptions.
description: FRS 101 applies to the individual financial statements of qualifying entities that are members of a group preparing publicly available consolidated IFRS accounts. It exempts entities from many detailed IFRS disclosure requirements, including cash flow statements, IFRS 7 financial instrument risk disclosures, IFRS 8 segment reporting, and certain related party disclosures, while keeping recognition and measurement identical to full IFRS. Unlike US GAAP's private company council alternatives, FRS 101 is purely a disclosure relief mechanism rather than a separate measurement basis.

bannerNotice.title: Relationship to IAS/IFRS
bannerNotice.body: FRS 101 retains full IFRS recognition and measurement with disclosure exemptions only, making it a pure disclosure relief mechanism. Unlike US GAAP's private company alternatives, it does not alter the underlying measurement basis.
